<thought>Using the retrosynthetic template for sulfonamide formation, the target sulfonamide can be disconnected into the aromatic amine fragment and the aryl sulfonyl chloride fragment. The amine fragment is the aromatic ring bearing the N‑substituents, and the sulfonyl chloride fragment is the para‑fluorophenyl sulfonyl chloride. Therefore the possible precursor pair is:

1. Aromatic amine: NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1  
2. Aryl sulfonyl chloride: ClS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(F)cc1

These two SMILES together constitute the only viable precursor combination for the given template.</thought>
<final_answer>[[\"NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1\", \"ClS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(F)cc1\"]]</final_answer>
